name: How to Play
author: Bonkheads rebuild
hint: A short guided level. Follow the tips at the bottom of the screen.

tutorial.start: Walk ← →, jump ↑ (P2: A D, jump S). A bulldog is coming along the platform above you. Stand under it and jump to BONK the bricks under its feet!
tutorial.bump: Bonk! Hitting a brick from below flips whatever is standing on it.
tutorial.flip: It's flipped for ~5 seconds! Climb up and run into it to KICK it. Climb by jumping up through the middle gap, then steer onto the platform.
tutorial.recover: Too slow: it got back up, angrier and faster. Bonk it again, then kick it quicker!
tutorial.kick: KICKED! A kicked pest is gone for good. Flip and kick every pest to clear a level.
tutorial.hit: Ouch! Touching a pest that's standing up costs a life. Only flipped pests are safe to touch.
